notes.title: ✨Quality of Life Demo Update!✨
notes.content:
The Quality of Life Update for the Jurassic Gym Demo is out right now!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3782040/Jurassic_Gym_Demo"][/dynamiclink]

QoL Update Changelog:

A new Jurassic Era invention... the Clipboard! A new Overview screen so you can quickly access a list of ALL dinosaurs and ALL equipment in one place! No more clicking on each individual item to find what you need. You can access the Overview in the popout menu in the bottom left of the screen.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45611124/8b5bb2bcb34d4a4a3ad473c4ad46265c20fb5410.png"]

Support for Ultra-Wide Displays added.

An assortment of UI bug fixes and adjustments (and performance improvements, wow!).



Download the update now and manage your gym with superior efficiency!

And as always, if you have any feedback or bug reports, you can always reach out on our Discord or Steam Discussion Board!



Have Fun!
